title: ConversationsCollection
description: MongoDB collection storing processed social media tweets, sentiment classification, and topic modeling labels.

tweet_id.description: Unique identifier of the social media post.

author_id.description: ID of the customer or support agent.

inbound.description: True if the post is from a customer, False if sent by support agent.

text.description: Raw uncleaned text of the post.

clean_text.description: Cleaned text with URLs, handles, and special characters stripped.

sentiment.description: Classified sentiment of the clean text.

sentiment_score.description: Numeric representation of sentiment (Positive=1, Neutral=0, Negative=-1).

confidence.description: BERT model classification confidence score (0.0 to 1.0).

conversation_id.description: Thread identifier grouping related customer-agent messages.

topic_id.description: Topic cluster ID assigned by BERTopic.

topic_keywords.description: Keywords defining the BERTopic cluster (e.g. 'login, password, reset').

spike_detected.description: Flag indicating if a volume anomaly was detected for this topic on this date (Z-Score >= 2).

response_time_minutes.description: Minutes elapsed before support responded to this inbound message.
